caseName: Greene v. Grievance Committee for the Ninth Judicial District
caseNameFull: Greene v. Grievance Committee for the Ninth Judicial District
judges: Ante, Blackmun, Brennan, Certiorari, Consideration, Light, Re, Remand, Vacate, White

opinions.text:
Ct. App. N. Y. Certio-rari denied.

Justice Brennan, Justice White, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Powell would grant certiorari, vacate the judgment, and remand the case for further consideration in light of In re R. M. J., ante, p. 191.
